svg.aria-label: The steps of /grill as boxes in order: resolve; design tree; a round; the answers; write down; close, with a return from write down to design tree until no decision is open, then a card for the lookup agent and a card for when it refuses: lookup agent; when it refuses. Each box lists the stops where you are asked, marked every run or only when.
